summary: Iteration 3 (footer Portal Admin, GBHI-style leadership carousel, paradigm editorial layout, full-site CMS editor with photo upload, SEO). Backend 24/24 tests passing (7 new CMS + upload + 17 regression). Frontend landing verifies paradigm-shift, people-carousel with person-card-0=Rudiantara initials, and footer-admin-link -> /admin/login. CMS end-to-end works: admin login → Editor Website tab → Hero section badge edited → Simpan → change appears on landing → Reset → landing reverts to default 'GRAND LAUNCHING — 17 AGUSTUS 2026'. Shared section shows image fields (Gambar Latar Hero/Program/Ajakan) with upload buttons and Tokoh & Pengurus list. Upload rejects .txt (400), accepts PNG (200), serves PNG bytes publicly via /api/files/{path}. SEO meta og:title/og:image/twitter:card and title 'GESOI — Gerakan Otak Sehat Indonesia' present. Site content cleared to {} after tests (verified via curl).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: /api/files/{path} loads full object into memory then returns Response — fine for small images but consider StreamingResponse for larger files and adding Cache-Control headers (currently no caching, image served on every landing load).
server.py: upload endpoint doesn't verify magic bytes — a renamed .exe.png would still pass extension+content-type checks. Low risk since only admin can upload, but worth noting.
server.py: PUT /api/admin/content accepts arbitrary dict with no size cap; a malicious/mistyped huge payload could bloat the site_content document. Consider a max body size (e.g., 512KB).
server.py: get_object / put_object are sync `requests` calls inside async endpoints — will block the event loop under load. Consider httpx.AsyncClient or run_in_threadpool.
AdminEditor recursive fields intentionally use createElement (per handoff note) — kept as-is.
seed_data_creation: PUT /api/admin/content with TEST_CMS_BADGE_XYZ then DELETE; one PNG uploaded to gesoi/uploads/ (test.png, ~70 bytes) and left in object storage; site_content collection cleared (GET /api/content -> {}).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All iteration-4 features verified end-to-end. Backend content APIs, upload/serve, editor CMS flow (Simpan + Reset with landing reflection), Portal Admin footer link, paradigm-shift editorial layout, people-carousel with initials avatars, and SEO meta all working. Previous iteration-2 lockout bug is now fixed (email-keyed). Site content is reset to {} — landing shows defaults.
rca of the issue: N/A — no issues found this iteration.
